summary: Haleon plc furnished a Form 6-K reporting its 2026 half-year results, including financial statements and a share buyback programme allocation. The filing is a routine periodic earnings report by the issuer, not a special situation. It contains no M&A, tender offer, restructuring, or activist activity; the buyback programme referenced is a routine capital return programme previously allocated. No deal terms, pricing, or recommendations are present. The event is simply a disclosure of interim financial performance, so it does not qualify for any special-situation category.
